methods.scope: Independent read-only PDF review under Kami and PDF skills; no source, CAD, PDF or page PNG modified.
methods.visual: Viewed all 12 existing page PNGs individually: no P0/P1 clipping, overlap, broken glyph, illegible table, or content-preservation defect.
methods.page_geometry: PyMuPDF verified 12 pages, each 420 x 297 mm (A3 landscape).
methods.kami_content: PASS: valid long-doc content; all 20 atomic values present; 30 prose fields not required verbatim.
methods.kami_fonts: PASS: TsangerJinKai02 drew 3985 CJK body ideographs.
methods.manifest: Verified 25 stages, 929 objects/components, 4149 summed solids; 13 assembly counts sum to 929 and agree with page 11.
preserve_evidence: Pages 1 and 12 explicitly distinguish the later SCPH-5500 family envelope from approximate SCPH-1000 dimensions and unverified internal geometry.
Page 2 preserves Japanese-original rear S-Video, RCA, RFU DC, serial, AV MULTI, parallel and AC interfaces.
Pages 3 and 6 show the original digital SCPH-1010 without analog sticks; page 3 shows eight rear fixings.
Page 4 exposes the pinion and return spring; its text explicitly disclaims verified motion.
Page 5 labels the actual model sections and cut planes; page 6 explains display offsets and omitted dense details.
Page 8 exposes the pickup, worm, reduction gear and rack; page 9 exposes shoulder contacts.
Page 10 shows grey SCPH-1020 card, two fixing positions and eight fingers, with sliding-cover text; pages 10 and 12 leave larger-board dating uncertain.
Page 10 preserves shortened display cables and a blank CD; page 12 excludes game data and production circuits.
Page 11 preserves component identifiers and separate component/solid counts; index text is legible.
methods.supporting_audits: Read drawing_checks.json (PASS; BRep projections, model endpoints and physical planar sections) and native_drawings_audit.json (PASS; 12 pages, 15 native dimension references). Native save/reopen and cross-export validation remain the parent workflow responsibility.
methods.hash_guard: PDF SHA256 matched the requested artifact before review and immediately before report creation.
